title: American Express 2022 Form 10-K — Regulation section: India RBI restrictions (p21)
key_points: Some countries require international card networks to be locally licensed and/or to localize aspects of their operations.
The Reserve Bank of India issued a mandate requiring payment systems operators in India to store certain payments data locally.
In 2021 the RBI imposed restrictions on American Express Banking Corp. from engaging in certain card issuing activities in India.
Those restrictions were lifted in August 2022 following significant investment in technology, infrastructure and resources to comply with the regulation.
raw_excerpt: In some countries, governments have established regulatory regimes that require international card networks to be locally licensed and/or to localize aspects of their operations. For example, the Reserve Bank of India … issued a mandate requiring payment systems operators in India to store certain payments data locally. In 2021, it imposed restrictions on American Express Banking Corp. from engaging in certain card issuing activities in India, which were lifted in August 2022 following significant investment in technology, infrastructure and resources to comply with the regulation.

title: American Express 2022 Form 10-K — Regulation section: Canada merchant surcharging (p21)
key_points: Effective October 6, 2022, merchants in Canada (other than in Quebec) are permitted to surcharge credit card purchases up to a maximum of 2.4 percent.
The Canadian surcharging change resulted from a litigation settlement with Visa and Mastercard.
Merchants in various countries, such as certain EU Member States and Australia, are permitted by law to surcharge card purchases.
raw_excerpt: In various countries, such as certain Member States in the EU and Australia, merchants are permitted by law to surcharge card purchases. … Effective October 6, 2022, merchants in Canada (other than in Quebec) are now permitted to surcharge credit card purchases up to a maximum of 2.4 percent as a result of a litigation settlement with Visa and Mastercard.

title: American Express Company 2022 Form 10-K — Our Integrated Payments Platform（闭环 closed loop 的官方定义）
key_points: Amex 通过通用卡发卡、商户收单与卡网络三项业务，同时与 Card Member（作为发卡方）和商户（作为收单方）保持直接关系，并自行处理这些关系的关键环节。
这些关系形成「闭环」（closed loop），即 Amex 对卡交易两端的信息均有直接访问权。
10-K 明确称闭环这一点将其整合支付平台与 bankcard networks（银行卡网络，即 Visa/Mastercard 类模式）区分开来。
raw_excerpt: Through our general-purpose card-issuing, merchant-acquiring and card network businesses, we are able to connect participants and provide differentiated value across the commerce path. We maintain direct relationships with both our Card Members (as a card issuer) and merchants (as an acquirer), and we handle all key aspects of those relationships. These relationships create a "closed loop" in that we have direct access to information at both ends of the card transaction, which distinguishes our integrated payments platform from the bankcard networks.

title: American Express Company 2022 Form 10-K — 差别附加费（differential surcharging）对 Amex 受理的劣势
key_points: 在允许附加费的司法辖区，Amex 卡在部分商户类别遭遇商户附加费。
